title: The Hugging Dragon
can_do: 不同意朋友的玩法时，说“我喜欢你的想法，但是……”，并提出融合方案。

conversation_move.label: disagree politely and offer a blend

trigger: The two friends imagine their pretend dragon differently, and Child speaks up kindly.
setting: A pretend game on the playroom rug.

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: Let's pretend our dragon is scary and mean!

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I like your idea, but scary dragons make me worried.

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: Not even a little bit scary?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Maybe a tiny bit scary, but mostly friendly.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: They can. Our dragon guards it with big hugs.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: And nobody steals treasure from a hug.

replay_cards.title: Which movie tonight
replay_cards.setting: Family movie night with two choices.
replay_cards.change: Child wants the dinosaur movie, Mom the cooking one.
replay_cards.challenge: Child disagrees politely with a reason and proposes one movie tonight and the other tomorrow.

replay_cards.title: The tower height
replay_cards.change: Max wants a sky-high tower, Child a strong one.
replay_cards.challenge: Child disagrees kindly, explains the wobble problem, and they settle on a wide base first.

parent_support: 孩子说“我不太同意”时先夸礼貌，再讨论内容。
引导他说出不同意的原因，而不是只说“不好”。
家庭里示范不同意：“爸爸喜欢A，但你说B也有道理。”
